name: Media Organizer 1.3.1
body:
**Bug fixes (reported by a real user):**
- The "Use suggested folder" chip now actually works when clicked — it fills in the destination and confirms visually
- The scan phase now shows a real progress bar with file counts, speed and **ETA** (previously indeterminate with no ETA)

Both fixes verified with automated tests that simulate real mouse clicks through the whole flow.

Download **MediaOrganizer-Setup-1.3.1.exe** below.
